in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess who bestows wealth and prosperity

in_marathi.name: Irsha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Irsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Irsha is a Sanskrit word that represents deep desire or passion. It is derived from the root 'rish' meaning to long for or to desire. In Hindu mythology, Irshana or Irshani is a divine goddess who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees.
